result:
All findings verified. Here are the answers:

## Hard questions

1. **h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (S3 presigned-URL refresher, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`) — every 12 hours via ticker (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27,30`); it re-presigns S3 attachment URLs (skipping ones still valid >4 days, `runner.go:85-91`) and saves via `UpdateAttachment` (`runner.go:116`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: constructed at `server/server.go:161`, immediate `RunOnce` at `server/server.go:162`, recurring `Run` goroutine at `server/server.go:165-169`.

2. **h02** — Delivery executes in `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual HTTP call `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`; `PostAsync` at `:184` just enqueues to a 128-slot channel drained by 4 workers, `:39-55`). Protection: SSRF guard rejecting reserved/private IPs — dial-time check `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`) plus admission-time `ValidateURL`/`isReservedIP` against `reservedCIDRs` (loopback, RFC-1918, link-local/IMDS, IPv6 ULA) — `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23,44,62`.

3. **h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3` — note it defines a shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` DTO, not a Go interface); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 — `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20,27`), consumed by `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:12-20`.

4. **h04** — No. `mysql.NewDB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`) has exactly one call site in the entire repo: the driver-selection factory `NewDBDriver` at `store/db/db.go:22`. A repo-wide grep for `mysql.NewDB` (including tests) yields only that hit; tests construct drivers only via `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/deployment_config_test.go:416`, `store/demo_seed_test.go:24`) or the factory itself (`store/test/store.go:28,50`).

5. **h05** — Explicit Go code, inside each driver's `DeleteUser` transaction. Checked: `Store.DeleteUser` delegates to the driver (`store/user.go:171-172`); each driver deletes reactions on the user's memos and reactions authored by the user — sqlite `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:92,383,401`, postgres `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:92,383,401`, mysql `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:92,420,438`. Schema check: `reaction` table has no foreign keys / no `ON DELETE CASCADE` in any dialect (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`); the only cascade is `memo_share → memo`. Behavior asserted by `server/router/api/v1/test/user_service_delete_test.go:287-298`.

6. **h06** — Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `:157`), `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:401` → `:513`), `DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:518` → `:562`), `CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` → `:119`), plus `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16`) and `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:16`) via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_update_helpers.go:66`). Memo-event paths converge in `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`); all paths (including the comment path at `memo_service_webhooks.go:43`) ultimately converge in the delivery function `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (fed via `PostAsync`, `:184`).

7. **h07** —
   - Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`
   - `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
   - `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
   - `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (falls through to `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`)
   - Driver `(*DB).ListUsers` — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (username predicate `:128`, `avatar_url` scanned `:189`; mysql `store/db/mysql/user.go:84`, postgres `store/db/postgres/user.go:87`)
   - Back in the handler: `parseDataURI` decodes the stored base64 data URI and serves bytes — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`, `:201-208`

8. **h08** —
   - `*s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked: yes — callers `server/server.go:162` (startup one-shot) and `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (its own ticker loop)
   - `*memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked: no — zero callers anywhere (dead code; the package is only used via the free function `RebuildMemoPayload`, called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`)

9. **h09** — 8 declarations total in backend Go code: 6 production — `*SSEHub` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `*store.Store` (`store/store.go:72`), `*cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `*sqlite.DB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `*postgres.DB` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `*mysql.DB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`) — plus 2 test-only (`store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`). Invoked by non-test server code: `Store.Close` from `server/server.go:146`; `Cache.Close` from `store/store.go:74-76`; the three DB drivers' `Close` via the `Driver` interface at `store/store.go:78`; `SSEHub.Close` from `server/server.go:206`.

10. **h10** — `(*filter.Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — ~38 callers (~31 test + 7 non-test, spread across 6 packages: `internal/filter`, the three `store/db/*` drivers, `server/router/api/v1` attachment and shortcut services).

11. **h11** — 1st: `store.User` (~11 distinct packages outside the store root, ~128 references); 2nd: `store.Memo` (~10 packages, ~162 references but one fewer package). Excluding the whole `store/` subtree the ranking holds: User 7 packages vs Memo 6.

12. **h12** — `(*DB).CreateMemo` in the SQLite driver — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (INSERT built at `:41`). Determination: the default driver is `sqlite` (`viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` at `cmd/memos/main.go:122`, flag default at `:130`; DSN defaulting for sqlite at `internal/profile/profile.go:110`), and the factory `NewDBDriver` selects the sqlite branch for that value (`store/db/db.go:14,19-20`); `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109`) dispatches through the `store.Driver` interface to that concrete method.

13. **h13** — Impl: unexported goldmark-backed `service` struct (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`) implementing `markdown.Service` (interface at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`) — constructed by `markdown.NewService` (`markdown.go:84`) in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`; test helper `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`) — holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected at `server/server.go:85`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, not wired in production).

14. **h14** — Computed in `RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`), which calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:352`) and fills `memo.Payload.Tags`/`Payload.Property`. Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`) and `UpdateMemo` when the `content` field is in the update mask (`memo_service.go:447`); the batch `Runner.RunOnce` (`runner.go:27`) exists but is never wired. Extracted: tags, plus property fields `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title` (first H1) — `proto/store/memo.proto:12-22`.

15. **h15** — Distinct visibility-enforcement sites:
    - Central read gate `checkMemoReadAccess` (used by `GetMemo` incl. parent-of-comment check) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39,55-63,356,367`
    - `ListMemos` visibility filter construction (anonymous → PUBLIC only; other users → PUBLIC+PROTECTED) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227` (same pattern for comments `memo_service_comments.go:157-160`, relations `memo_relation_service.go:108-111`)
    - Attachment gRPC access check `checkAttachmentAccess` (gates on parent memo's visibility) — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422,445-451` (also `memo_attachment_service.go:214-224`)
    - File-byte serving `FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650,677-699` (invoked at `:149`)
    - Reaction listing/upsert checks — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30,38,83`
    - RSS feeds restricted to PUBLIC — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`; sitemap PUBLIC-only — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
    - SSE event fan-out filter `SSEClient.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-136`
    - User-stats visibility filtering — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90,218-220`

## Reality checks

1. **r01** — False premise: there is no Redis anywhere (zero grep hits in code or `go.mod`). The cache layer is a hand-rolled in-memory cache backed by `sync.Map` (`store/cache/cache.go:67-69`) with a background eviction loop (`cache.go:83`). User cache entries get a 10-minute TTL: `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, cleanup every 5 minutes, max 1000 items — `store/store.go:41-43`, caches instantiated at `store/store.go:51-53`.

2. **r02** — False premise: no per-user (or any) API rate-limiting middleware exists in the repo; the only "rate limit" mention is an aspirational comment in `internal/email/doc.go:86`. The closest request protection is a request-body size cap (`maxAPIRequestBytes`, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:126,141`).

3. **r03** — False premise: there is no nightly database-cleanup job and no cron job registered at all. `internal/scheduler` is a cron library referenced only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `integration_test.go:13`). The only scheduled background work is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour ticker (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`, wired at `server/server.go:153-169`).

4. **r04** — Neither: false premise — no NATS, RabbitMQ, or AMQP anywhere (zero grep hits). Webhooks are delivered in-process: `PostAsync` enqueues onto a buffered Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128, dropping when full — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39,184,191-195`), drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `init()` (`webhook.go:42-55`) that make direct HTTP POSTs via `Post` (`webhook.go:120,152`).

5. **r05** — False premise: there is no GraphQL schema (zero grep hits). The public API is protobuf-defined (`proto/api/v1/`) and served as gRPC-Gateway REST plus Connect RPC over Echo: gateway registration in `RegisterGateway` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:65,96-126`), Connect handlers in `RegisterConnectHandlers` (`server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:31-44`, invoked at `v1.go:141`), wired at `server/server.go:88`.
